Should the plumbing scope receive a new unrelated job number or a subsequent filing under the existing job?","userFacts":[],"conversationFacts":{"established":[],"hypothetical":[],"qualified":[],"unknown":[]},"recentConversation":[],"retrievalLimitation":null,"passages":[{"sourceID":"dob-application-guide","claimID":"official-passage-789cc7ccd439eb8374132031","title":"DOB NOW application user guide","url":"https://www.nyc.gov/assets/buildings/pdf/dob_now_application_user_guide.pdf#page=5","page":5,"contentHash":"9befc1cc76dd0efbfb76fed2960c262f1c4a61fc8dd786f9c30341251cc852b5","text":"Page 5 of 38
JOB FILING /APPLICATION
A job is an application submitted for a construction project on a property, which can vary from making alterations to a single unit in an
existing building or to constructing a new building with many units. A job filing/application is submitted to obtain a Work Permit to
perform a specific type of construction.
All filings related to the same construction project should have the same job number and then an alphabetic and numeric extension that
indicates the filing type and sequence: I - Initial, S - Subsequent, and P - Post Approval Amendment (PAA).
• Initial Filings (I1) – The first or initial job filing created for a construction project .
• Subsequent (S) - A subsequent filing is an additional filing under the same job filing number that allows an applicant (the same one
on the initial or a new applicant) to add new scope of work and new work types to a job on the same property. A subsequent filing
can have a different review type (standard plan examination/professional certification) than the initial filing. Once submitt ed, a
subsequent filing functions as a separate appli cation. It can be permitted before the initial is permitted and a Letter of Completion
(LOC) is requested separately on each filing.
• Post Approval Amendment s (PAA) - A Post Approval Amendment or PAA is for making changes to a filing after it has been approved.
To create a job fi ling , log into DOB NOW: Build and from the dashboard select +Job Filing . Then select the Job Type , Work Type (s) , and
Filing Review Typ e .
Subsequent applications are strongly encouraged. All filings with the same job number will go to the same plan examiner or team and the
Records Management Fees are paid on the initial filin g only. It is also beneficial to have one job number to connect all of the work on a
project.","heading":"PDF page 5","intro":null,"extractionLimitations":["PDF text extraction preserves whole pages; diagrams, scanned content, and complex table geometry are not independently verified."]},{"sourceID":"dob-application-guide","claimID":"official-passage-5b682c1399f57019c03eda89","title":"DOB NOW application user guide","url":"https://www.nyc.gov/assets/buildings/pdf/dob_now_application_user_guide.pdf#page=6","page":6,"contentHash":"9befc1cc76dd0efbfb76fed2960c262f1c4a61fc8dd786f9c30341251cc852b5","text":"Page 6 of 38
To create a subsequent filing, select Search from the dashboard . Select BIN Search to find filings on the BIN or select Job Number Search
if the job number is alr eady known. From the Filing Action column next to the initial (I1) filing, select action Subsequent Filing .
J ob T ypes
Alteration – Questions about the scope of work are provided to determine if the filing is an Alteration CO or an Alteration CO – New Building with
Existing Elements to Remain. If No is the answer for all the questions, then the filing is an Alteration (does not require an amended CO) .
• Alteration required to meet New Building requirements? (Yes = Alteration CO – New Building with Existing Elements to Remain)
• Alteration is inconsistent with the current Certificate of Occupancy? (Yes = Alteration CO)
• Alteration in occupancy or use? (Yes = Alteration CO)
• Alteration is a major chan ge to exits? (Yes = Alteration CO)
• Alteration in number of stories? (Yes = Alteration CO if Building Type is 3 Family or Other)
Full Demolition - The dismantling, razing, or removal of all of a building or structure, including all related incidental opera tions . The Full
Demolition Types are: New Work, Emergency Declaration, Immediate Emergency Declaration, Emergency Work Order, and Precept. A
registered design professional (PE/RA) is required as the applicant on a full demolition filing when one or more of the f ollowing
conditions are met:
• Building is greater than 3 stories in height
• Building is greater than 5,000 square feet per floor

"},{"spanIndex":1,"text":"JOB FILING /APPLICATION
"},{"spanIndex":2,"text":"A job is an application submitted for a construction project on a property, which can vary from making alterations to a single unit in an
"},{"spanIndex":3,"text":"existing building or to constructing a new building with many units. "},{"spanIndex":4,"text":"A job filing/application is submitted to obtain a Work Permit to
"},{"spanIndex":5,"text":"perform a specific type of construction.
"},{"spanIndex":6,"text":"All filings related to the same construction project should have the same job number and then an alphabetic and numeric extension that
"},{"spanIndex":7,"text":"indicates the filing type and sequence: I - Initial, S - Subsequent, and P - Post Approval Amendment (PAA).
"},{"spanIndex":8,"text":"• Initial Filings (I1) – The first or initial job filing created for a construction project .
"},{"spanIndex":9,"text":"• Subsequent (S) - A subsequent filing is an additional filing under the same job filing number that allows an applicant (the same one
"},{"spanIndex":10,"text":"on the initial or a new applicant) to add new scope of work and new work types to a job on the same property. "},{"spanIndex":11,"text":"A subsequent filing
"},{"spanIndex":12,"text":"can have a different review type (standard plan examination/professional certification) than the initial filing. "},{"spanIndex":13,"text":"Once submitt ed, a
"},{"spanIndex":14,"text":"subsequent filing functions as a separate appli cation. "},{"spanIndex":15,"text":"It can be permitted before the initial is permitted and a Letter of Completion
"},{"spanIndex":16,"text":"(LOC) is requested separately on each filing.
"},{"spanIndex":17,"text":"• Post Approval Amendment s (PAA) - A Post Approval Amendment or PAA is for making changes to a filing after it has been approved.
"},{"spanIndex":18,"text":"To create a job fi ling , log into DOB NOW: Build and from the dashboard select +Job Filing . "},{"spanIndex":19,"text":"Then select the Job Type , Work Type (s) , and
"},{"spanIndex":20,"text":"Filing Review Typ e .
"},{"spanIndex":21,"text":"Subsequent applications are strongly encouraged. "},{"spanIndex":22,"text":"All filings with the same job number will go to the same plan examiner or team and the
"},{"spanIndex":23,"text":"Records Management Fees are paid on the initial filin g only. "},{"spanIndex":24,"text":"It is also beneficial to have one job number to connect all of the work on a
"},{"spanIndex":25,"text":"project."}]},{"passageIndex":1,"sourceID":"dob-application-guide","claimID":"official-passage-5b682c1399f57019c03eda89","contentHash":"9befc1cc76dd0efbfb76fed2960c262f1c4a61fc8dd786f9c30341251cc852b5","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"Page 6 of 38
"},{"spanIndex":1,"text":"To create a subsequent filing, select Search from the dashboard . "},{"spanIndex":2,"text":"Select BIN Search to find filings on the BIN or select Job Number Search
"},{"spanIndex":3,"text":"if the job number is alr eady known. "},{"spanIndex":4,"text":"From the Filing Action column next to the initial (I1) filing, select action Subsequent Filing .
"},{"spanIndex":5,"text":"J ob T ypes
"},{"spanIndex":6,"text":"Alteration – Questions about the scope of work are provided to determine if the filing is an Alteration CO or an Alteration CO – New Building with
"},{"spanIndex":7,"text":"Existing Elements to Remain. "},{"spanIndex":8,"text":"If No is the answer for all the questions, then the filing is an Alteration (does not require an amended CO) .
"},{"spanIndex":9,"text":"• Alteration required to meet New Building requirements? "},{"spanIndex":10,"text":"(Yes = Alteration CO – New Building with Existing Elements to Remain)
"},{"spanIndex":11,"text":"• Alteration is inconsistent with the current Certificate of Occupancy? "},{"spanIndex":12,"text":"(Yes = Alteration CO)
"},{"spanIndex":13,"text":"• Alteration in occupancy or use? "},{"spanIndex":14,"text":"(Yes = Alteration CO)
"},{"spanIndex":15,"text":"• Alteration is a major chan ge to exits? "},{"spanIndex":16,"text":"(Yes = Alteration CO)
"},{"spanIndex":17,"text":"• Alteration in number of stories? "},{"spanIndex":18,"text":"(Yes = Alteration CO if Building Type is 3 Family or Other)
"},{"spanIndex":19,"text":"Full Demolition - The dismantling, razing, or removal of all of a building or structure, including all related incidental opera tions . "},{"spanIndex":20,"text":"The Full
"},{"spanIndex":21,"text":"Demolition Types are: New Work, Emergency Declaration, Immediate Emergency Declaration, Emergency Work Order, and Precept. "},{"spanIndex":22,"text":"A
"},{"spanIndex":23,"text":"registered design professional (PE/RA) is required as the applicant on a full demolition filing when one or more of the f ollowing
"},{"spanIndex":24,"text":"conditions are met:
"},{"spanIndex":25,"text":"• Building is greater than 3 stories in height
"},{"spanIndex":26,"text":"• Building is greater than 5,000 square feet per floor
"},{"spanIndex":27,"text":"• Building is not detached
"},{"spanIndex":28,"text":"• Demolition Is using mechanical equipment
"},{"spanIndex":29,"text":"• Foundation is not being removed"}]},{"passageIndex":2,"sourceID":"dob-application-guide","claimID":"official-passage-5bdd162d6e75ae930ee42abc","contentHash":"9befc1cc76dd0efbfb76fed2960c262f1c4a61fc8dd786f9c30341251cc852b5","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"Page 19 of 38
"},{"spanIndex":1,"text":"Does this application include a new roof or the replacing of an entire existing roof deck or roof assembly? "},{"spanIndex":2,"text":"(GC work type)
"},{"spanIndex":3,"text":"If yes is selected, Local Law 92/94 of 2019 Sustainable R oof Zone will populate in the Required Documents section.
"},{"spanIndex":4,"text":"Is this application filed in connection with a development, enlargement, or change in use, as defined in Zoning Resolution Se ction 12 - 10? "},{"spanIndex":5,"text":"(FO, ST,
"},{"spanIndex":6,"text":"SE and EA work types)
"},{"spanIndex":7,"text":"If yes is selected, enter a related New Building, Alteration CO or Alteration with enlargement job filing number. "},{"spanIndex":8,"text":"DOB NOW wil l check if there is an
"},{"spanIndex":9,"text":"approved ZD1 and site safety plan on the related job when the permit is created.
"},{"spanIndex":10,"text":"In Conjunction New Building BIS Job Numbers
"},{"spanIndex":11,"text":"Provide any existing New Building BIS job number that is on the same BIN.
"},{"spanIndex":12,"text":"Related DOB NOW/BIS Job Numbers
"},{"spanIndex":13,"text":"P rovide any existing job filing numbers that relate to this application and are on the same BIN. "},{"spanIndex":14,"text":"Do not inc lude any filings with the same job number
"},{"spanIndex":15,"text":"(subsequent filings). "},{"spanIndex":16,"text":"It always preferred to create subsequent filings rather than adding job filing numbers to this field.
"},{"spanIndex":17,"text":"Additional Considerations, Limitations or Restrictions
"},{"spanIndex":18,"text":"Landmark . "},{"spanIndex":19,"text":"Approval from the Landmarks Preservation Commission (LPC) is required to ensure that work proposed under the application
"},{"spanIndex":20,"text":"does not affect the property’s designation, including buildings, structures or places located with in a historic district designated by the
"},{"spanIndex":21,"text":"LPC or designated as an individual landmark. "},{"spanIndex":22,"text":"LPC approved drawings must be submitted prior to filing. "},{"spanIndex":23,"text":"This selection is auto - populated
"},{"spanIndex":24,"text":"if the BIS property profile indicates it is a Landmark.
"},{"spanIndex":25,"text":"Review is requested under which Building Code. "},{"spanIndex":26,"text":"Indicate under which building code the review is being requested — 2022, 2014, 2008,
"},{"spanIndex":27,"text":"1968, or prior to 1968. "},{"spanIndex":28,"text":"See the 2022 Construction Codes Updates to DOB NOW guide , pages 4 - 6, for code review selection options based
"},{"spanIndex":29,"text":"on job type, filing date and work type .
"},{"spanIndex":30,"text":"The below job types are selected when creating the job and cannot be changed in this section.
"},{"spanIndex":31,"text":"- Alteration required to meet New Building requirements
"},{"spanIndex":32,"text":"- Alteration is a major change in exits
"},{"spanIndex":33,"text":"- Alteration in occupancy or use
"},{"spanIndex":34,"text":"- Alteration is inconsistent with current certificate of occupancy
"},{"spanIndex":35,"text":"- Alteration in number of stories
"},{"spanIndex":36,"text":"Loft Board: A Loft Board C ertificate is a R equired Document for alteration of a registered Interim Multiple Dwelling (IMD) building. "},{"spanIndex":37,"text":"If the
"},{"spanIndex":38,"text":"BIS property p rofile indicates t he LOFT designation , ‘Yes’ is auto - populated."}]},{"passageIndex":3,"sourceID":"dob-subsequent-faq","claimID":"official-passage-0331bd114a1e55398f206b9e","contentHash":"3212c1e798dab74153aecc605e2db885f7c1daaabd6463bba1f5c18c41a2640a","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Subsequent Filings — When can I submit a subsequent job filing? — Subsequent filings can be initiated and submitted after the initial job filing is submitted (not in pre-filing status). "},{"spanIndex":1,"text":"Users no longer have to wait until the initial filing is approved. "},{"spanIndex":2,"text":"A subsequent filing can be submitted anytime until an LOC has been issued for the initial filing.
"},{"spanIndex":3,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":4,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Subsequent Filings — Do I have to request a Letter of Completion (LOC) for a subsequent job filing? — Yes, an LOC needs to be requested for each filing, initial and subsequent filings.
"},{"spanIndex":5,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":6,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Subsequent Filings — If an initial job application is filed as professional certification can the subsequent application be filed as a standard plan filing type? — Yes, initial and subsequent jobs can have different filing types.
"},{"spanIndex":7,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":8,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Subsequent Filings — Can a subsequent filing have a different design applicant than the initial filing? — Yes, the applicant on an initial filing and a subsequent filing can be different. "},{"spanIndex":9,"text":"If the applicant is the same, one application can be submitted if the work types are eligible to be combine filed.
"},{"spanIndex":10,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":11,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Subsequent Filings — Do I have to pay the record management fee on a subsequent filing? — No, the $165 record management fee is now charged only once on the initial filing and is no longer a fee on subsequent filings.
"},{"spanIndex":12,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":13,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Subsequent Filings — Can I have an open PAA for the initial filing and a subsequent filing at the same time? — Yes.
"},{"spanIndex":14,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":15,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Subsequent Filings — How can I make a minor change to a legalization filing? — Post-Approval Amendments (PAA) are not allowed on filings that include legalization work. "},{"spanIndex":16,"text":"If a change needs to be made, a subsequent filing will be required or the job must be withdrawn and refiled. "},{"spanIndex":17,"text":"For Boiler Equipment filings the only option is to withdraw and refile the job. "},{"spanIndex":18,"text":"In addition, permits cannot be renewed if the job includes legalization work.
"},{"spanIndex":19,"text":"
"},{"spanIndex":20,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > Subsequent Filings — I have a subsequent filing in pre-filing status and some of the fields are grayed out? "},{"spanIndex":21,"text":"How do I complete these fields? — Fields from the subsequent filing are populated from the initial filing (I1). "},{"spanIndex":22,"text":"The fields will not update on the subsequent filing until the I1 is submitted. "},{"spanIndex":23,"text":"To prevent this issue, we recommend completing as much of the I1 as possible before creating the subsequent filing."}]},{"passageIndex":4,"sourceID":"dob-nb-altco-faq","claimID":"official-passage-d25e5d634f67e6c4f122ad28","contentHash":"02b1a07ce73421ac58714221f9b6966bb89a75a4c3a3d81c1b74cbe7477f9660","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > New Building and Alteration-CO — Are Structural (ST) and Foundation (FO) work types required for New Building (NB) filings? — Each NB should have FO and ST work types that may be combine filed with the General Construction (GC) in the initial application if the applicant is the same or filed as subsequent filings to the GC work type."}]},{"passageIndex":5,"sourceID":"dob-nb-altco-faq","claimID":"official-passage-a9f2e262ed308f26503f48f3","contentHash":"02b1a07ce73421ac58714221f9b6966bb89a75a4c3a3d81c1b74cbe7477f9660","spans":[{"spanIndex":0,"text":"DOB NOW: Build Frequently Asked Questions > New Building and Alteration-CO — Do I need to request a Letter of Completion for the subsequent filing of an NB or Alteration-CO filing? — No, the status of the subsequent filings will remain Permit Entire. "},{"spanIndex":1,"text":"Only the status of the initial (I1) filing will change to CO issued. "},{"spanIndex":2,"text":"If a Temporary CO is issued, the status of the initial job will remain Permit Entire until the Final CO is issued."}]}]}}
